items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So Miss Burgorne(?) said, 'Did you come to the decision, Danny?'

ctx.x: He said, 'Man, I wouldn't play no part like that. In case your people come up to see you on the stage and you're out there swishin' like some woman, man.' He said, 'Man, I wouldn't do that.' He says, 'Suppose your relatives come.' They said, 'Oh, man, relatives. This is the stage.' They had a big argument. 'This is the stage. He's just an actor. You're just portraying a character. You ain't...' Smitty said, 'I wouldn't care what it is.' He said, 'I'd be a lover, but I ain't gonna be no goddamn morphodyte on the…

So Miss Burgorne(?) said, 'Did you come to the decision, Danny?' I said, 'No, Miss Burgorne(?), I ain't gonna play that part.' She said, 'Oh, that was the chance for you. You don't get a chance but once in a lifetime. You could be in the Theatre.' So that killed that.
